This video was made possible thanks to everyone on the Simple History Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/simplehistory

Why Soviet paratroopers slid off plane wings instead of jumping: Red Army TB-3 crews climbed onto the wing, held steel cables, and dropped as a group to avoid dispersal under deep-battle doctrine. Bold 1930s idea—limited wartime payoff after Barbarossa. Ever seen a jump start on the wing?
